body: Every agx picker or command that can act on 'here' or 'everywhere' defaults to the current folder, takes --all for everywhere, and never widens scope on its own: `sessions move -i` lists this folder's chats; a folder with none exits 1 with 'no chats in <dir>; use --all to pick from every folder'. `agx ws` / `resume -b` are global by design. Owner's rule 2026-10-14.
